## S0 landed for review as ADR 0112; a shared-checkout ownership finding

**S0 (7dfa / livid-blondish-shearwater) passed plan review, claimed, committed, pushed as
Gerrit change 2598.** The ADR is docs/adr/0112-on-box-disk-ceiling-architecture.md.

**The first plan-review run BLOCKED, correctly, on something I had missed.** The single
blocking finding (criterion G7) was parent/child divergence: I had renumbered the child ADR
twice (0110 -> 0111 -> 0112) but never propagated either correction UP to the parent epic,
which still named docs/adr/0110-gerrit-disk-ceiling-architecture.md in its AC1, its "ADR draft
location" note, and its file_impact. So the epic promised 0110 while the story delivered 0112.
Fixed by updating the epic's description and all 12 file_impact paths. This is a failure mode
worth checking proactively on ANY renumber or rename -- a leaf correction that silently leaves
the parent stale -- rather than waiting for a gate to catch it.

The re-run PASSED with zero blocking findings and one minor advisory (2 acceptance-criterion
lines bundle deliverables with "and"). Left as-is rather than churning the attestation after
the claim.

Also corrected the ROOT of the whole collision chain, which was in S0's own research section:
the plan asserted "highest current number is 0109" when 0110 had already landed in commit
8f19115cf2fb. Because the .numbers/ reservation marker is only created when an ADR is
AUTHORED, any plan that reads the highest number at planning time is stale by landing time.
Two concurrent drafters will keep colliding. If it happens a third time, that is a mechanism
problem deserving its own ticket.

**Commit-message gate detail worth remembering:** the pre-commit hook enforces a 50-char
subject and 72-column body wrap (Gerrit renders the description as preformatted text).
Trailers, URLs, table rows and fenced code are exempt. My first attempt was rejected on six
long lines and an over-length subject; the fix is to wrap, not to bypass.

**Shared-checkout ownership finding (asked by the user).** The primary checkout at
/Users/joeoakhart/rebar currently holds 14 MODIFIED source files that are NOT this session's:
an LLM / code-review / reconciler cluster (_mcp_llm.py, llm/code_review/shim.py,
_cli/_llm_commands.py, _cli/_parsers/advanced/llm.py, _engine/rebar_reconciler/last_pass.py,
_engine_support/bridge_fsck.py plus their tests, including test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py),
timestamped 02:51-07:21 today in two or three distinct bursts. Verified these are NOT Gerrit
change 2592's despite the shared "shim" theme -- 2592 touches only docs/api-stability.md,
docs/architecture.md, two test files and the 0111 ADR trio. So a third session has uncommitted
work there. LEFT STRICTLY ALONE. All of this session's code work has been in worktrees.

**But one untracked file in that checkout WAS ours, and it was a mistake.** The subagent
driving bug 9a17 ran its plan review from the repo ROOT and redirected output to
`.rp-9a17.log` there. Two problems: it littered a checkout holding another session's WIP, and
-- more seriously -- that run used the stale global pipx rebar, whose own warning reads "this
rebar build (cdfd7d94d, 2026-08-29, dirty) is 195 commit(s) BEHIND the ref this gate pinned
(08a39c39c) ... results can be wrong in ways the verdict cannot show". AGENTS.md requires the
repo checkout's build when developing rebar itself. Messaged the subagent to create its
worktree FIRST, re-run the gate from inside it with the worktree venv on PATH, confirm `which
rebar` resolves there before trusting any verdict, and remove only that one stray file.

Contrast: the S0 gate runs used `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"` from the worktree and
reported only "1 commit BEHIND" -- the correct posture. **The venv-on-PATH rule is not just
about the commit hook finding ruff/mypy; it also determines which rebar BUILD evaluates a
gate.** A subagent brief should say so explicitly, because the failure is silent.

**Gerrit now:** 2593 (sizing split) LLM+1, CI re-running after patchset 2. 2594 (composer
split) LLM+1, CI re-running after the recheck. 2598 (ADR 0112) awaiting both votes.
2596 (acli split) MERGED and now the tip of origin/main at 08a39c39c50d.

**Board:** 3 orphan bugs in_progress (3276, 9ea3, bff5), 2 orphan bugs dispatched to subagents
(740d triage-only; 9a17 full cycle). Epic 6202 in_progress, S0 in_progress, S6 next -- it is
the precondition for S2-S5 because the janitor reclaims by high-water mark over
delete-on-last-close, so a cap below peak concurrent hold cannot be honoured by reclamation.
